  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  April 09, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st
Floor. On April 09, 2026, at 2:03 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services Department

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on March 26, 2026

Approval of the minutes of the special meeting held on March 26, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Daniel Medina, on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host an Inglewood STEM Fest Event
  at 700 Warren Ln, Edward Vincent Jr. Park Champion Field – Public Property, on Saturday,
  April 18, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. APPROVED Approval for 1 day event at Edward
  Vincent Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park. Applicant is
  responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations.
  Approved; IPD will staff this event with two (2) police officers for public safety and two (2)
  TCOs for traffic safety at ingress and egress points of parking lots. (2) City Hall security
  officers will be requested via Public Safety Spvr. Emory Ward to assist IPD with any
  potential crowd control; Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply
  with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact of the person in charge of
  sound and acoustics volume control; No recommendations needed for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
 Permits & License Committee  April 09, 2026

  protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426855)

Item #2:  Erica Robinson, on behalf of Matters Clinic to host a Live Unstoppable Walk / Run Event
  at 123 W Manchester Blvd, Curtis Tucker Wellness Center, Public Property, on Saturday,
  May 09, 2026, from 8:15 a.m. to 9:45 a.m. from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. APPROVED
  Approval for 1 day event at Curtis Tucker Wellness Center and on the public sidewalk.
  Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant responsible
  for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; Approved:
  Applicant will need to hire two (2) police officers for public safety and four (4) TCO's for
  intermittent traffic control. Police & TCO's will lead-follow the participants and provide public
  safety and traffic control services. Applicant will arrange for a min. of two (2) security guards
  to remain at the Tucker Health Center to assist IPD with any potential crowd control. NO
  drone usage, applicant aware. Adhere to all local, state and federal laws Conditions for
  amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-27 and IMC 5-29.; No
  recommendations needed for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426817)

New Business License Renewal Request (s):
Item #3:  Heliodoro Amezcua on behalf of DBS Dalaja’s Barber Shop to operate as a Barber Shop
  Business at 319 Arbor Vitae St APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees;
  Business owner must possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from
  the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and
  Manicurists operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the
  State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and
  Manicurists operating within the establishment is required to register and file business tax
  with the City; Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued
  identification and copies of applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person
  operating within the establishment to the Finance Department;Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic
  drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises; Massage therapy
  of any part of the body is not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code
  Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all
  State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application requests.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426726)

Item #4:  Chibueze Chima on behalf of Tribe Entertainment Center Parking to operate as an Outdoor
  Restaurant Business at 446 S Market APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Obtain
  annual approval from the Permits and License Committee for events and live entertainment
  at the site;ALL patrons / employees shall have valid identification to be inside and remain
  as an employee or paying customer at the location (Bar area only). Valid ID shall be
  available upon request to any law enforcement or code enforcement officer(s);Applicant
  shall post NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS in front/outside of the business as
  well;The applicant or his / her designee are subject to random permit & license /
  establishment inspections at ANYTIME of the day or night, by any police or code
  enforcement officer(s), including California Department of Alcohol Beverage Control
  Investigators. The purpose of random inspections are to ensure that the listed
  establishment are adhering to the regulations set forth by the State of California Alcohol
  Beverage Control, City of Inglewood / Permits & Licensing committee; Adhere to Resolution
  No. 1836 – SP -2019-005 in its entirety; and Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply
  with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application requests.Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426859)

New Tobacco Retailer License Renewal Request (s):

Item #6:  Tarek Abdelfattah on behalf of Zee Market to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 10717 S
  Prairie  Ave. This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
  condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee: Must adhere to all City of
  Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically, CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS
  FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere
  to all State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or
  69 sq feet of total retail floor area Sales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited;
  Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods,
  Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos,
  Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-
  your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored
  Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited;Tobacco or smoke shop retailers are required to
  immediately remove any Kratom related products, including natural Kratom and any
  products containing 7-OH, from store shelves and cease all sales; Sales of tobacco,
  hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited;
  Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have a valid
  government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type
  of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited;
  Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are subject to
  random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by
  any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to enforce
  business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood for
  Community Public Health & Safety; California State Board of Equalization Tobacco
  Retailers license must be current; Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within
  existing business ONLY; NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to
  minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco
  products SHALL have a valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction of
  underage tobacco use, including hookah products; Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable; NO loitering of persons outside of the location; NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible outside of the business. Proof of
  signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke/ingest
  illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are
  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,

  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.); Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
  police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police
  response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement,
  Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); and The following is not allowed inside
  the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit:
  PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke box),
  NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC.
  APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR
  NIGHT) OF OPERATION. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426758)
